description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Combining Gray and Green Infrastructure to Protect Coastlines Through Wave Attenuation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Daniel Cox, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). The project discussed in this paper explores the combination of wave attenuation and wave overtopping equations to determine if the relationship is linear. The results and discussion section of this paper focuses on the wave attenuation aspect and the impact that gray and green infrastructure have together on reducing the energy of waves. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-eqhr-fc75. Keywords: NHERI O.H. Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory; Wave Attenuation; Wave Overtopping; Rhizophora mangle; Red Mangroves; Green Infrastructure; Nature-Based Solutions;. Published 2023-08-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
